Text: WHEN the loyalty service creates a pending points transaction, the loyalty service shall award 1 point per SGD 1 of the purchase amount, rounded down per transaction.
Rationale: Earning rule in the programme terms.

Text: WHEN a member requests the balance, the loyalty service shall return the posted points and the pending points separately.
Rationale: Members ask why new points are not usable yet (S-03).

Text: IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption with the reason "below minimum".
Rationale: Minimum redemption in the programme terms.

Text: WHEN 12 months have passed since points were posted, the loyalty service shall expire those points.
Rationale: Programme terms; Finance needs a bounded points liability.

Text: WHEN posted points are within TBD days of expiry, the loyalty service shall send the member an expiry reminder through the notification provider.
Rationale: Reminders reduce complaints about lost points (S-03).

Text: WHEN a support agent adjusts points, the admin console shall require a reason code.
Rationale: Adjustments without reasons cannot be audited.

Text: The loyalty service shall let members transfer expired points back to their balance.
The loyalty service shall retain points transaction records for 7 years.
The loyalty service shall pseudonymise member identifiers in transaction records older than TBD months.
Rationale: PDPA minimisation while keeping the 7-year audit trail (RDR-001).
